item.title: Hive Mind — a feed algorithm you own (project write-up)
item.author: Bernardo Stearns
item.description:

TL;DR: a browser extension that replaces Big-Tech feed ranking with models trained on annotations from a small circle of people you trust — private by construction, improving with every correction. This post is the design write-up; the build is in progress.
